title: Remove the absolute storage size ceilings so a 1 GB, 5 GB, or any document the process can hold is parsed and saved in Swift, TypeScript, and Rust. Callers may still set a lower limit. Length and count integers grow past 256 MB. Coordinate integers stay at 4 bytes.
description: Remove the absolute storage size ceilings so a 1 GB, 5 GB, or any document the process can hold is parsed and saved in Swift, TypeScript, and Rust. Callers may still set a lower limit. Length and count integers grow past 256 MB. Coordinate integers stay at 4 bytes.
acceptance_criteria: Default limits parse and save a document larger than 64 MiB, including a real 1 GB round trip and a 5 GB limit value, as text and as kind 2. Non-positive limits are still rejected. Callers can still set a lower limit. Small kind-2 files stay byte-identical. Coordinate integers stay 4 bytes. A length above 256 MB uses a longer integer. CI does not allocate 1 GB or 5 GB.
